families.topic: isolation, urgent notification and exposure management for suspected measles
families.page_title: Information on measles for health professionals
evidence_points: The guidance advises isolating suspected cases and directing in-person presentations to a side room.
It states that measles cases are infectious from 4 days before rash onset through 4 full days after.
It advises urgent notification to the local UKHSA health protection team.
It highlights vulnerable contacts including infants, pregnant people and immunocompromised people.

families.page_title: How to stay safe during a measles outbreak
evidence_points: The guidance describes common measles symptoms including fever, respiratory symptoms and rash.
It advises checking that children receive 2 doses of measles-containing vaccine.
It advises people with suspected measles to stay home and telephone their GP or NHS 111.
It advises warning healthcare services before attending in person to reduce onward transmission.
